root_cause: The already protected and merged #4540 economics migration was not deployed because the combined transaction's index DDL timed out with PostgreSQL 57014; the old unbounded economics function continued to run.
prevention_rule: Stage only the exact protected #4540 function and server-only privileges in a short fail-closed migration before separately applying its index under a safe lock and pool budget; preserve 50-record batching, historical backlog, economics evidence, canonical cron, and tenant authority.
